basic_info.description: Situated on the coveted North Slope of Potrero Hill, 764 Arkansas enjoys iconic downtown and green space views directly across from the serene park of Potrero Hill Rec Center.     Natural light floods every room, highlighting a desirable open-concept living and dining area with shiplap details. The remodeled kitchen is both spacious and functional, featuring a skylight, induction range, and generous cabinetry.  Step outside to a private, sunny garden retreatlandscaped with lemon and lime trees, a deck with heat lamps for entertaining, and your own outdoor sauna & shower. Upstairs, you'll find two bedrooms: one with sweeping city and Bay views, the other opening to a private brand-new deck overlooking the backyard. A third bedroom and bonus office/den is located on the main level.    The large garage  offers space for 1-2 cars with EV charger, a workshop and includes a  bathoffering exciting renovation potentialwhile the driveway provides side-by-side parking for two more vehicles. Recent upgrades include a new roof, new HVAC with heat pump & A/C.    Enjoy Potrero's famously sunny weather, quick access to 280/101, 15 minutes from SFO and unbeatable proximity to the #10 bus line, Caltrain, Mission Bay, Chase Center, library, and neighborhood cafs.
